correctness.rationale: The conductor calculation is correct: A={f in F_7[t]:f(1)=f(-1)}=F_7+(t^2-1)F_7[t], so A/I=F_7 and B/I=F_7 x F_7. Double-relative K-theory is the total homotopy fiber of the conductor square, giving the standard long exact corner sequence. Quillen gives K_3(F_7)=Z/48 and homotopy invariance identifies K_3(F_7[t]) with it; both evaluations t=+/-1 induce the same map, so the image in K_3(F_7 x F_7)=(Z/48)^2 is the diagonal and its cokernel Z/48 injects into K_2(A,B,I). Fresh finite-group arithmetic independently reproduced the diagonal cokernel. The claim is only a subgroup statement; the full K_2(A,B,I) is not computed.
